messages:
Maya Chen: Heads up — noticed 7 candidates in the SRE req have their scorecards missing after the CSV bulk import this morning. Candidates show interviews completed but scorecard fields are blank. @Emily (People Ops) can you take a look? :eyes:

ATS Bot: Bulk import job 2026-06-03T14:02:17Z completed with warnings. Step 'attach_scorecards' returned 206 Partial Content. Job ID: job_20260603_140217. Logs: https://ats.example/jobs/job_20260603_140217

Arjun Patel: I emailed the interviewers already asking them to re-upload but that's not ideal. We need to restore attachments for those candidates in case interviewers are out. Which table/field should we check?

Kelly Ramos: I can run a check. Quick query to find affected interviews:```sql
SELECT i.id, i.candidate_id, s.scorecard_id
FROM interviews i
LEFT JOIN scorecards s ON s.interview_id = i.id
WHERE i.req_id = 'REQ-2026-SRE' AND s.scorecard_id IS NULL AND i.completed_at IS NOT NULL;
```
That will list interviews that finished but missing scorecards.

Emily (People Ops): Thanks Kelly. If the CSV included a scorecard column it should have attached automatically. Two possibilities: mapping header mismatch (e.g., "score_card" vs "scorecard") or the API returned 422 for attachments and the job didn't retry. For a short-term fix, we can run a reattach script using the original CSV payload. Quick curl example to reattach by interview id:```bash
curl -X POST 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ATS_TOKEN" 
  -F "interview_id=INTERVIEW_ID" 
  -F "scorecard=@/path/to/scorecard.json" 
  https://ats.example/api/v1/interviews/attach_scorecard
```
I'll prepare a small script to iterate the 7 affected rows.

Arjun Patel: Perfect. If you share the script I can run it in the recruiter account. Also can we add a safety-net: flag candidates where scorecard is null but interview is marked complete so we don't miss these next time?

Kelly Ramos: Agreed — adding an alert rule is low effort. I can add a scheduled query that creates an internal ticket when count > 0. I'll also dump the list to a CSV for archival: columns -> candidate_id, interview_id, interviewer_email, completed_at, original_csv_row_id.

Sam P: Thanks team. One follow-up: this batch revealed some interviewers forgot to use the calibrated scorecard template. Can we run a 30-minute calibration refresh next Tue/Thu (two slots) for Eng managers + frequent interviewers? I'd prefer Tue 11:00 and Thu 16:00 as options. Keep it short and focused on rubric alignment. :thumbsup:

Emily (People Ops): Good catch, Sam. I'll schedule two 30-min calibration sessions and post materials in the hiring toolkit docs. Draft agenda: 1) Scorecard walkthrough (5m) 2) Rating examples & edge cases (15m) 3) Quick live calibration on 3 anonymized snippets (10m). Link to prep doc: https://intranet.redwood/hiring/calibration-2026 (will post after confirm).

Maya Chen: Quick note — before we run reattach, please snapshot the current DB rows and export the job logs. We should have roll-forward evidence in case of mismatches.

Emily (People Ops): Will do. I'll open an internal ops ticket with labels: ats-bulk, scorecard-missing, priority-medium and attach DB snapshot + job logs. ETA for script run + reattach: EOD today if no blockers. ETA for calibration invites: tomorrow EOD.

Arjun Patel: Sounds good. @Maya Chen tagging you so you can validate the candidate list once I run the reattach script.

Maya Chen: 👍 I'll review after the script runs. If anything looks off I'll escalate to eng for a deeper retry mechanism.

ATS Bot: Ticket created: INT-4521 (ats-bulk-scorecard-mismatch) by Emily (People Ops). Priority: P2. https://internal.redwood/tickets/INT-4521

Kelly Ramos: Added the alert rule to monitoring (name: 'ATS: missing scorecards post-import') — it will run every hour and create a ticket if results > 0.

Emily (People Ops): Closing loop here. I'll update INT-4521 with timelines and attach the reattach script. Thanks everyone! :white_check_mark:
